'''December 1999 Boca Raton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Boca Raton, FL on 19 December 1999. [[Mike Belfatto]] won it. It is known from Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d147">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-19-two-of-a-feather-boca-raton-fl-12-19-99d147/ two-of-a-feather-boca-raton-fl-12-19-99], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 19 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-19-two-of-a-feather-boca-raton-fl-12-19-99d147/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 December 1999
* '''Site:''' Boca Raton, FL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Mike Belfatto]]
